trades.note: Replay (backtest, not live) of the current gold rules on HistData spot XAU/USD 1m, 2023 - Oct 2026, after a 0.30 spread: replica v5 (2+ M15 ATR leg, M5 CHoCH, clear of H1 Origins or ★, stop ≥ 1 M15 ATR, against the H4 trend), only while gold's 20-day average daily range ≥ 1.5%, in the daily trend direction or from a live H1 engulfing barrier; stop past the extreme (round-number rule); from +2R the stop trails 2R behind, cap 10R, out after 48 h; max 3 open, −1.5R daily stop, half size below the 50-trade equity average.
